title: Splendors of Sri Lanka with Mirissa
highlights: Immerse yourself in the rich cultural heritage of Kandy, exploring the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic and watching the captivating traditional dance performances
Explore the picturesque town of Nuwara Eliya, reminiscent of colonial times, and revel in its cool climate and charming architecture
Unwind on the pristine beaches of Bentota, indulging in water sports and boat rides along the scenic Madu River
Dive into the vibrant capital, Colombo, where modernity meets tradition and explore the bustling markets of Pettah and savor the diverse local cuisine
Indulge in diverse local cuisine, from street food in Pettah to upscale dining in Colombo, experiencing the city's vibrant culinary scene
overview:
About the Tour:
Have a memorable time on a trip to Sri Lanka, a country brimming with cultural richness, natural wonders, and warm hospitality. Enjoy the bustling markets and colonial charm of Colombo, where the clash of modernity and tradition paints a vibrant tapestry. Explore ancient temples in Kandy, including the revered Temple of the Tooth Relic, steeped in centuries of history and spiritual significance. The verdant tea plantations of Nuwara Eliya offer a refreshing escape, with cool mountain air and scenic landscapes that invite leisurely walks and immersive tea experiences.
Sri Lanka's biodiversity unfolds with encounters with majestic elephants, vibrant birdlife, and the captivating flora of Hakgala Botanical Gardens. Whether exploring ancient ruins, savoring the world-renowned Ceylon tea, or contributing to turtle conservation efforts along the coast, a trip to Sri Lanka is an odyssey that leaves indelible memories and a profound appreciation for the island's captivating allure.
inclusions: Transfer from Bandaranaike International Colombo Airport to Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
2 nights stay in Kandy with breakfast
1 night stay in Nuwara Eliya with breakfast
2 nights stay in Bentota with breakfast
1 night stay in Colombo with breakfast
Transfer from Deluxe Hotel to Bandaranaike International Colombo Airport
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of arrival.
All foreign nationals must share their passport and visa details at the time of arrival.
All international and domestic airfare, visa fees, airport tax, or any kind of insurance cover is not a part of the package.
Any personal expenses or items of personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the resort will be charged at actuals.
The hotels are subject to their availability. In case they are not available, the travelers will be accommodated in a property of similar standard.
Avoid using plastic bags and maintain the ecological balance of the destinations. Travelers littering may be fined.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.desc: Upon arrival, the representative will pick you up from the Bandaranaike International Airport and take you to your hotel in Kandy. On the way, visit the Pinnwala Elephant Orphanage and look at rescued Asian elephants. Arrive in Kandy and check in to your hotel. Later in the evening, take in the picturesque vistas on Upper Lake Drive and enjoy a Kandyan Dance performance with a spectacular finale. After the visit, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya | Explore The Little England
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and get transferred to Nuwara Eliya. Upon arrival in Nuwara Eliya, the representative will take you on a sightseeing tour of Nuwara Eliya. Visit a tea plantation and get insights into its production. Then, visit the Hanuman Temple. Continue to the beautiful Ramboda Falls. Then, head to the famous Seetha Amman Kovil. Then, visit Hakgala Botanical Gardens. After sightseeing, get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay in Nuwara Eliya.

items.title: Nuwara Eliya Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Take a leisurely stroll through the picturesque tea plantations and learn about the cultivation process.
Visit the Hanuman Temple, a serene Hindu shrine dedicated to Lord Hanuman and admire the intricate architecture of the temple.
Visit the Ramboda Falls, one of Sri Lanka's highest waterfalls and marvel at the vistas of cascading water surrounded by lush greenery.
Explore the Seetha Amman Kovil, a Hindu temple steeped in cultural and religious significance and learn about the temple's association with the Ramayana legend.
Wander through the Hakgala Botanical Gardens and explore themed gardens, including the rose garden and fernery, showcasing a variety of plant species from different regions.

days.title: Nuwara Eliya to Bentota | Visit The Madu River
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and get transferred to your hotel in Bentota. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and get ready for a sightseeing tour of Bentota. Visit Madu River, where you can enjoy a scenic boat ride. Then, head to Kosgoda and visit the turtle hatchery. See adorable turtles and learn about the conservation efforts put in to save them. After sightseeing, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Bentota.

items.title: Bentota Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Visit Madu River and enjoy a relaxing stroll along the river with scenic vistas.
You can enjoy a scenic boat ride on the Madu River and enjoy the picturesque views as you cruise.
Explore the turtle hatchery and learn about the different species of turtles, their life cycles, and the challenges they face in the wild.

days.title: Excursion to Mirissa | Spot the largest animal on the planet
days.desc: After breakfast, the representative will pick you up from the hotel and take you on an excursion to Mirissa. Upon arrival, visit Mirissa Beach and take in the vistas of golden sand lined with palm trees. You can spot the Parrot Rock, a huge red-colored mound that towers over the water. You can also visit Coconut Hill and marvel at the panoramic views of Mirissa Beach and the Indian Ocean. Post excursion, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Bentota

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:

After excursion, get transferred back to your hotel in Bentota for an overnight stay.

items.title: Excursion to Mirissa
items.desc:
Relax and soak up the sun on Mirissa Beach, a crescent-shaped stretch of golden sand lined with palm trees. 
You can visit Coconut Hill and admire the scenic views of the surroundings with swaying coconut palms.
You can also join the Whale watching tour at an additional cost.

days.title: Bentota To Colombo | The Commercial Capital of Sri Lanka
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and get transferred to your hotel in Colombo. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and get ready for a sightseeing tour of Colombo. Explore the Colombo Fort and visit the Old Dutch Hospital. Then, take in the views of the city from the Lotus Tower. Continue to Lover’s Island. Head to World Trade Building and see the city from a different perspective. After sightseeing, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Colombo.

items.title: Colombo Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Marvel at the architecture of the Colombo Fort Railway Station, a colonial-era train station at the Colombo Fort.
Explore the narrow streets lined with shops selling spices, textiles, and a variety of goods at the bustling Pettah Market.
Marvel at the panoramic views of Colombo's skyline from the observation deck at Lotus Tower.
Enjoy a leisurely stroll along the scenic promenade by the ocean at Lover's Island.
Take in the views of the city from a different perspective from the World Trade Center.
